cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: This is the later (2010-11 era) form face: it carries BOTH a top-row 'Office' box and a separate 'Office Sought' box, and the Final block is titled 'FINAL / DISSOLUTION REPORT'. The top-row Office box is blank, so office_sought is taken from the 'Office Sought' box ('Council', district 'At Large'). Column B is headed 'Aggregate Total' and is blank on both lines. The cover's signature Date line is blank, so report_date comes from the Summary Page header ('Jan. 31/11'); the clerk stamp is RECEIVED JAN 31 2011, i.e. this is the year-end report FOR 2010 filed in Jan 2011. All money cells write the cents as a raised superscript. Arithmetic is exact (28,112.58 + 5,500.00 = 33,612.58; less 6,100.00 = 27,512.58). Neither amendment box is checked.
